        "All 247 owned diff lines across three paths were read. The native future comparison changes now + 1800 to now + 1800 * PR_USEC_PER_SEC, keeping a strict greater-than comparison; numeric cutoff values are also added to debug logs. The exact existing units lesson is reused, with fresh source support rather than a duplicate claim.",
        "The changed SQL test helper accepts Date or string input, converts ISO time through UNIXEPOCH * 1000000 and directly checks named date groups, historical years and +11/+22/+33-minute cases. Those cases bracket the half-hour grace but do not test the exact equality boundary. The adapter inserts +10 minutes as today and +one hour as future, with ten new checkDateGroup calls across existing insertion cases.",
        "The new checkDateGroup helper directly asserts stmt.row.dateGroup equals expectedGroup with no message argument. The SQL-function helper already supplies date_grouped(input) should return expectedOutput. A test name or surrounding row comment is not an assertion message; this is a new shared-helper diagnostic gap, distinct from missing should alone.",
        "The adapter creates one statement before its existing try block, resets after each helper query and finalizes in the existing finally after adapter.setTree(null). It still has no assertion on executeStep success itself. Existing fixture code stores Date milliseconds multiplied by 1000, so the group checks consume persisted microseconds. No new unconditional-cleanup or missing-row behavior is inferred from those statements.",
        "The complete primary preserves the pasted undefined-message log and the author's missing-factor diagnosis; sibling 2026642 and linked logs remain unread. The complete own review has no inlines/history edits and explicitly lands with ongoing/failed builds after an ESLint report. Neither approval nor the source factor proves a fresh timeout cure, clean lint, DST or native/JS midnight equivalence. Existing focused midnight-boundary analysis remains separate.",
